one_liner: Customer support ticketing and helpdesk platform.

auth.evidence_quote: Using OAuth to authenticate API requests
auth.notes: API tokens are used via HTTP Basic auth (email/token as username, token as password); OAuth supports authorization-code and client-credentials flows.

access.evidence_quote: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.
access.notes: Dev access is via 14-day trial account (or sponsored account program); no perpetual free dev tier found. Marketplace app review is only required to be publicly listed, not to call the API.

api.evidence_quote: Using OAuth to authenticate API requests
api.notes: No official Zendesk-published MCP server found at research time; Zendesk announced plans for an MCP client but no confirmed GA server. Community repo (reminia/zendesk-mcp-server) exists.

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 and API-token auth are self-serve via a trial/sandbox account with no extra approval gate to call the API.
